text:
mira: Heads up — small refresh to the quickstart (hello-sprint). Adding PKCE + minimal Python snippet and a short section on local token helper 'decklink'. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4377. Looking for: snippet check (py + js), an install checksum for decklink, and a Linux smoke test.

jon: I can do the JS snippet review. Please include env var names (REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID, AUTH_DOMAIN) and a curl example to exchange code.

elaine: Don't call out the old cookie helper. Add migration one-liner instead. Also add SDK compatibility note (>=0.9.0).

ci-bot: CI: docs-build succeeded for PR #4377 — preview: https://deploy-preview-4377--redwood-docs.netlify.app/hello-sprint.html

qa-alex: I'll run Linux smoke (Ubuntu 22.04) in ~2 hours and report back. Steps needed?

mira: Thanks — run: npm ci, npm run dev, ./decklink auth --client-id $REDWOOD_CLIENT_ID --redirect http://localhost:3000/callback, then curl to exchange code. Open the app and ensure the hello card renders.

qa-alex: Smoke done — decklink installs, token flow completes, UI shows "Hello, QA". Noted small wording nit about redirect URI advice.

mira: Applying wording nit and adding checksum link. Will merge after one quick doc spellcheck. Thanks all! :)
